status: Secondary blog inspiration only; no official Kalypta paper, checkpoint, SDK or reproducible configuration was established in this review.
target_difference: Blog aims to prevent ASR transcription. This project instead preserves original ASR content while disrupting unauthorized voice cloning.
corrections: ISO 226 equal-loudness contours do not establish an inaudibility threshold for arbitrary adversarial perturbations.
A 20ms frame description and <12ms end-to-end latency require an explicit causal/window/lookahead accounting that the blog does not provide.
Official Treble describes wave-based FEM and geometrical acoustics; the blog Maxwell-equation attribution is not supported by the inspected official description.

verified_related_sources.observation: Official platform describes wave-based FEM, geometrical acoustics, synthetic audio and acoustic validation; its company-level claims do not verify the blog Kalypta examples.
